title: Notarization Envelope
nlang_code:
mod blocks NotarizationEnvelope {
  props {
    aph_version: str,
    context: Directional<str>,
    type: Directional<str>,
    id: str,
    issuer: str,
    valid_from: str,
    valid_until: str,
    credential_subject: CredentialSubject,
    #[optional(true)]
    linked_mandate: LinkedMandate,
    proof: EnvelopeProof,
  }
}
note: The APH credential: a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0-shaped document binding one outbound agent action to the human authorization behind it. A verifier re-canonicalizes the envelope and checks the signature over those bytes, so every prop is part of what was signed — adding, removing, or renaming one describes a different credential. `aph_version` is pinned to "0.1" and a verifier rejects versions it does not support.
